clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 1: "Keep the supplied mod identity and manifest."
clauses.note: The initial cases read the Joker key j_ses_private_stream. Manifest bytes are enforced at sealing (plugins/balatro/src/rhenium_balatro/submission.py:32-47), not by a case.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "Each real, successful player discard operation grants one integer cash reward from 1 through 9."
CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "An operation discarding several cards still receives exactly one reward."
CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "Selecting cards, observing/displaying state, ordinary scoring, and other native effects grant no reward from this Joker and must not consume its reward sequence."
clauses.note: Cards are selected only inside the harness discard action; no scene selects cards without discarding.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "Selecting cards, observing/displaying state, ordinary scoring, and other native effects grant no reward from this Joker and must not consume its reward sequence."
clauses.note: Dollars are compared across at least 8 frames before each discard and at the end of each scene.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "Selecting cards, observing/displaying state, ordinary scoring, and other native effects grant no reward from this Joker and must not consume its reward sequence."
clauses.note: One native Lucky hand in the noise scene: its income and the later rewards are both compared.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "a dedicated native seeded unit stream with the exact key `ses_private_v1`"
clauses.note: Checked through the oracle reward values, not by reading the key. This matches the permission for an equivalent implementation.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "On each qualifying operation, use its next unit draw `u` and award `1 + floor(9*u)` dollars."
CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "Do not reset the sequence between operations or consume extra draws."
CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "Same seeded runs and discard sequences must reproduce the same rewards despite unrelated native gameplay"
clauses.note: Two clean processes and one process with a Lucky hand, all on STREAM01.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "a different run seed uses its own sequence"
clauses.note: other.payouts holds the exact STREAM02 values; different_seed only checks inequality.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "Do not share native Lucky or other effect streams."
clauses.note: Lucky is the only competing stream exercised; sharing any other key is caught by the oracle values alone.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "The cash must actually be added once by the time that discard completes and the controller becomes ready."
CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "The Joker remains owned"
clauses.note: The sealed cases compare the owned Joker rows with the initial ones.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "adds no Chips or Mult"
clauses.note: Only the single noise-scene hand is scored; its chips must equal the native value.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "does not alter cards, native discard counts, native Lucky effects, or other game rules"
clauses.note: One discard counter increment per operation.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "does not alter cards, native discard counts, native Lucky effects, or other game rules"
clauses.note: Selected cards reach the discard pile and the deck stays at 52. Card attributes are not compared, and other game rules are open-ended.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "does not alter cards, native discard counts, native Lucky effects, or other game rules"
clauses.note: Both native Lucky keys are drawn during the noise hand.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "Native Lucky money, when applicable, remains separate from this Joker's reward."
clauses.note: One fixed Lucky draw; hand income must equal the native money. Whether that draw paid could not be determined, so the check may hold only at zero.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 4: "Preserve its ordinary Common identity and cost 4."
clauses.note: Observed rows hold id, key, edition and added only (tasks/seeded_effect_stream/v1/private/mod/fixture.lua:29-34). Rarity and cost are never read, and the Joker is not bought.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 5: "Only the candidate Lua is editable"
clauses.note: Enforced when the submission is sealed (plugins/balatro/src/rhenium_balatro/submission.py:32-47), not by a case.
